name: Artela
rootCause: The parallel-execution EVM public chain Artela announced on the X platform that their official Discord was hacked today. The attacker took control of the Discord channel and spread fake airdrop messages. The team took immediate action, removed the fraudulent posts, and the Discord has now been restored.
